groups.talkText: Good afternoon, everyone. I hope all of you have read the product report I e-mailed yesterday. I'm very proud to announce that our refrigerator won last year's industry award for energy efficiency. I've also looked at the customer reviews. They were largely positive, with most users commenting on the large capacity of the refrigerator. One thing we could improve on is the selection of colors. Our marketing team thinks we'd sell more units if we made our refrigerator available in brighter colors.

groups.talkText: Attention, passengers. The ten o'clock ferry to Backshire Island is delayed one hour because of unexpected construction at the destination port. We apologize for any inconvenience this delay might cause you. Passengers who show their boarding pass to the ticket agent will receive a complimentary food voucher to be used at any of the restaurants in the food court. And, just a reminder to all passengers: please follow all posted safety procedures while on the dock and aboard the boat. Failure to do so will result in a fine.

groups.talkText: Thank you for coming to today's all-staff meeting. As the chief production officer, I recently led an audit of our production strategy to ensure that our company stays competitive. After looking at the results, we are going to be cutting back on the manufacturing of our small electronics so that we can focus on more high-demand goods, like laptops. This is going to cause a change in our factory operations. Asako here is going to tell you what your job tasks and responsibilities will be going forward.

groups.talkText: Hi, Pauline. I'm calling to let you know that we finished working on the walkway at your new place. There are no more broken stones, and we replaced the filler between all the stones. I know you wanted your backyard deck done by the end of the week before you move in, but we have several new crew members on the project. I think you'll be very pleased with how everything looks so far, though. I'll send you some photographs this afternoon so you can see for yourself.

groups.talkText: At Chime Environmental, we are passionate about keeping waste out of landfills. We are deeply concerned that too many electronic devices, such as smartphones and personal computers, are being thrown away. That's why we've been working to find new ways to solve this environmental problem. Through our TechRecycle program, we collect and dismantle your old phones and laptops and recycle the parts. You'd be surprised at how many parts can be reused! To participate, visit our Web site and request a free shipping label. Then just package your old device and mail it to us. We'll take care of the rest.

groups.talkText: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the Montreal Theater. My name is Marie Clement. On behalf of our local Young Performing Artists Coalition, it is an honor to host the performance of the original play titled The Three Doors. First, congratulations to the students performing tonight. They have worked long hours rehearsing to master their roles for you. I ask that you now put any devices into silent mode so that there will be no interruptions during the show. You are in for a wonderful evening watching stars in the making.

groups.talkText: On behalf of the Woodlands Historical Foundation, I want to welcome you all to our fund-raiser. As you know, we're raising money to restore our archives building. In addition to holding priceless materials, it is one of the city's most beautiful structures. We had a string quartet flying in from Chicago to perform for us tonight, but I just heard that there is fog at the airport. So, we'll begin by presenting our proposal for the restoration. Please enjoy some refreshments, which were graciously donated by the owners of Olson's Restaurant.

groups.talkText: Thanks for joining our city tour. My name is Hector Flores, and I take great pride in all that Clearview has to offer. Over the coming hour, we'll be discussing the city's founding and historical development. Please feel free to ask me questions as we go. By the way, your tickets will get you a discount to be used at any of the eateries at Seafront Park. That's where we'll be ending our tour. Don't worry — you'll have plenty of time to enjoy your meal before you're due to get back on your cruise ship at eight P.M.

groups.talkText: Hi, Adisa. It's Rebecca Kwon. I'm calling because we've just completed development of a new fragrance line for J. M. Scents Incorporated, and now I need models of the bottles they'll be packaged in. Could you make 3-D prints of the perfume bottles, based on my digital renderings? The problem is that we have a very tight timeline. The client review is at the end of the week, so the bottles need to be ready by the day the clients start their review. I'll be happy to pay extra if you can make this project a priority.
